name: Chattanooga State Community College
academic_ranking: Public two-year community college in the Tennessee Board of Regents system, accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools (SACSCOC). Roughly 10,000 undergraduates (federal College Scorecard reports enrollment of ~5,284; NCES ~7,600 depending on year/measure). Seven academic departments span business/IT, engineering technology, humanities and fine arts, math and sciences, nursing and allied health, social/behavioral sciences, and the integrated Tennessee College of Applied Technology (TCAT). Notable for the Volkswagen Academy and Wacker Institute technical training partnerships. As a community college it is open-enrollment and not ranked among selective national universities.
financial_aid: Tuition figure ($4,772/yr) is the in-state annual tuition/fees per the federal College Scorecard; out-of-state tuition is approximately $17,756/yr. Tennessee residents may qualify for the TN Promise (last-dollar scholarship covering community college tuition/fees for recent high school graduates) and TN Reconnect (for adult learners), which frequently make community college tuition-free for eligible in-state students. Federal Pell Grants, state grants, and institutional aid are administered through the Chattanooga State financial aid office. As an NJCAA/JUCO program, athletic aid is limited (see scholarship notes); specific softball award amounts were not published on the pages fetched.
facilities_notes: Chattanooga State Tigers softball competes as an NJCAA program on the Chattanooga State campus in Chattanooga, TN. Specific stadium/field name and facility specifications were not enumerated on the official softball pages fetched (chattstatetigers.com, powered by PrestoSports). Athletics department social account: x.com/chattstathletic.
program_reputation: Established NJCAA Region VII / TCCAA softball program with a strong history — the Tigers won the 2012 NJCAA Division I softball national championship. Head Coach Blythe Golden leads a staff of two assistant coaches for the 2025-26 season.
